title: The Risks of AI-Driven Tech Decisions

scenes.text: AI is making risky decisions without oversight in tech companies!
AI technologies are often implemented without comprehensive testing, leading to unforeseen consequences.
Recent studies show AI can misinterpret data, causing flawed outcomes in decision-making.
Oversight is critical; we must not let machines govern our futures.
